<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Define a brand-new process path"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/process-paths"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Rejects with 409 if the given pathId is already defined — active or deactivated. A path's identity is permanent once created; a caller wanting to re-use an id after deactivation must be told explicitly, never silently overwritten. Publishes ProcessPathCreated on success.


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[ -~]+$"},"description":"Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0011, REST guideline section 2): 1-128 printable ASCII characters. Postgres is the only runtime (ADR 0037), so the check is on in every deployment: a missing key is answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one with 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`; a replay with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the original response plus `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.","example":"0b6b1f1e-4a5c-4c1e-9f2a-7d3c8e5f9a01"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
